import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter
# For each pair: split into two blocks, compute anomaly mask per block (cell != majority-of-block), tabulate (a,b)->out-3 counts.
def blocks(I,O,sepkind,c or None,ax=None):
    h=len(I); w=len(I[0]); oh,ow=len(O),len(O[0])
    if sepkind=='col':
        c=ax; A=[[I[r][cc] for cc in range(c)] for r in range(h)]; B=[[I[r][c+1+cc] for cc in range(ow)] for r in range(h)]
    else:
        ax_=ax; A=[[I[rr][cc] for cc in range(ow)] for rr in range(ax_)]; B=[[I[ax_+1+rr][cc] for cc in range(ow)] for rr in range(h-ax_-1)]
    la=Counter(v for row in A for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    lb=Counter(v for row in B for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    An=[[1 if x!=la else 0 for x in row] for row in A]
    Bn=[[1 if x!=lb else 0 for x in row] for row in B]
    On=[[1 if O[r][c]==3 else 0 for c in range(ow)] for r in range(oh)]
    return An,Bn,On

def find_split(I,O):
    h=len(I); w=len(I[0]); oh,ow=len(O),len(O[0])
    res=[]
    for c in range(w):
        if len({I[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1:
            A=[[I[r][cc] for cc in range(c)] for r in range(h)]
            B=[[I[r][c+1+cc] for cc in range(ow)] for r in range(h)]
            if ow==len(A[0]): res.append(('col',c,A,B))
    for r in range(h):
        if len({I[r]})==1:
            AA=[[I[rr][cc] for cc in range(ow)] for rr in range(r)]
            BB=[[I[r+1+rr][cc] for cc in range(ow)] for rr in range(r+1,h)]
            if len(AA)==oh: res.append(('row',r,AA,BB))
    return res

for p in range(1,9):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    hits=[]
    for kind,c_,A,B in find_split(I,O):
        An,Bn,On=blocks(I,O,None,None,None)
        # rebuild blocks inside loop properly
        from collections import Counter
        la=Counter(x for row in A for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        lb=Counter(x for row in B for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        An=[[1 if x!=la else 0 for x in row] for row in A]
        Bn=[[1 if x!=lb else 0 for x in row] for row in B]
        On=[[1 if O[r][c]==3 else 0 for c in range(len(B[0]))] for r in range(len(B))]
        okXOR=all((An[r][c]^Bn[r][c])==On[r][c] for r in range(len(B)) for c in range(len(B[0])))
        okAND=all((An[r][c]&Bn[r][c])==On[r][c] for r in range(len(B)) for c in range(len(B[0])))
        hits.append((kind,(okXOR,okAND)))
    print(p,'splits:',hits)
